description:
Make the docs describe the repo as it IS. Stale, dead and duplicated documentation is archived or corrected — never silently deleted.

MEASURED IN THIS REPO ON 2026-09-03: **1 of 14 docs carry no `Status · Updated · Owner` banner**.

DEPENDS ON THE CODE SWEEP, DELIBERATELY. Removing dead code changes what the docs should say, so documenting first means documenting twice.

THE STANDARD IS ALREADY WRITTEN AND IS NOT THIS TASKLIST'S TO INVENT: five root files, seven directories under `docs/` (`tutorials` `guides` `reference` `explanation` `decisions` `runbooks` `archive`), `docs/README.md` links every document, every file opens with a `Status · Updated · Owner` banner, and **nothing is deleted — it is archived** with a note saying what replaced it. Spec: `rosetta/docs/reference/documentation-standard.md`.

ROADMAPS ARE OUT OF SCOPE. `ROADMAP.md` and the roadmap plans under `docs/*/roadmap/` were reconciled portfolio-wide on 2026-09-02/03 and state their own evidence standard. Do not re-mark them here.

ARCHIVE, DO NOT DELETE. The standard says so and this portfolio has paid for the alternative: five consolidated strategy documents were unrecoverable except through one paragraph of prose. An archived doc with a note saying what replaced it costs nothing and answers the question a reader will actually have.

userStories.title: Every document is reachable, banner-stamped, and in the right place
userStories.notes: Swept, not read. 0 dead file links and 0 dead anchors across 22 markdown files (a naive slugifier reports 25 false anchor positives on this tree's spaced em dashes — GitHub maps each space to its own hyphen). Banner gaps: 1 of 17 docs/ files -> now 0 (docs/guides/tusd-integration.md, stamped Live). Index gaps: 2 -> 0. Directories outside the standard's seven: 1 (android/BUILD.md) -> 0, moved to docs/reference/android-build.md with a dated move note; grep over every file in the tree found no citation of the old path. No declared exceptions were needed. GATE: .chief/verify.sh = 4 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, exit 0. The skip is 'Gradle build - no JDK on PATH', the documented local condition (CLAUDE.md section 3). Per that rule this is NOT green; it conceals nothing about this story, which moved one document and no Kotlin.
acceptanceCriteria: Dead internal links are repaired or the target is archived with a pointer. A link to a document that no longer exists is worse than no link: it asserts the document is current.

Every `docs/` file carries a `Status · Updated · Owner` banner. Where a doc is stale rather than current, the banner is where that gets SAID — `Status: Superseded` with what replaced it beats a silent edit.
`docs/README.md` links every document. Unlinked is unreachable, and unreachable documentation still greps as current — which is how a reader finds it and believes it.
Directories outside the standard's seven are either justified in writing as declared exceptions or their contents are moved. Do not move a directory other files cite without repointing them.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.

userStories.title: Content that describes a tree that moved
userStories.notes: Read against the tree, not skimmed. 10 drifted claims across 8 reference docs, each corrected with a dated `## Corrections` section naming what the doc said, what the code says, and what was read to tell them apart. Biggest: state-machine.md §3 (the NORMATIVE event list) named `SetPriority` + 5 environment signals that exist in neither port, omitted `Schedule`/`SourceResolved`/`SourceMissing` that its own §2 table uses, and listed 5 TransportError classes where both ports declare 7; persistence-and-recovery.md §2 named `metadata`/`policy` (actually `metadataJson`/`policyJson`), a policy field `allowedNetworks` that does not exist, a `sourceKind` domain neither port declares, omitted `remoteTerminated`, and specified an `upload_event` ring NEITHER PORT IMPLEMENTS (kept as a declared gap, not deleted). Code-sweep fallout reflected: licensing.md still listed `androidx.core:core-ktx` as declared after 6d16ac7 removed it. 3 facts stated twice and DISAGREEING reduced to one home: ios-job Swift-concurrency error count (conformance-vectors.md said 3, continuous-integration.md said 2 — CI run 33044503283 says 2, at NetworkGovernor.swift:23:26 and TUSKitTransport.swift:27:17); pinned tusd version (platform-constraints.md said v2.10.0, the Compose digest pin says v2.4.0); and whether TUSKit is a dependency (it is not — Package.swift declares zero external packages). Also: `Upload-Incomplete` → `Upload-Complete` in 2 docs; `gradle :android:assemble` → `./gradlew`. Verified counts that DID hold: 40/39/1/3 vectors, all 16 per-key row counts in conformance-vectors.md §3.1, 46 Swift cases, the 4 KiB/0 KiB I6 numbers, the 5 CI jobs and 4 triggers. Link sweep after the edits: 22 markdown files, 0 dead file links, 0 dead anchors; 17/17 docs/ files still banner-stamped. GATE: .chief/verify.sh = 3 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, exit 0 (Swift build PASS, Swift tests PASS '46 passed', TypeScript typecheck PASS; the 4th check, TypeScript dependency install, only runs when node_modules is absent). The skip is 'Gradle build — no JDK on PATH', the documented local condition (CLAUDE.md §3). Per that rule this is NOT green: it means Android is unverified locally. It conceals nothing about this story, which changed no Kotlin. Tests/Conformance/check-single-fixture.sh exit 0.
acceptanceCriteria: Read the docs against the tree and correct what has drifted — paths, commands, module names, counts, and any claim the code no longer supports. This is the half a link-checker cannot do and the half that actually misleads.
Anything the code sweep removed is reflected here. A doc describing deleted code is the most confidently wrong kind.

Duplicated documentation — the same fact stated in two places that can disagree — is reduced to one home with the other pointing at it. Two copies of one fact is the same defect as two implementations of one behaviour.
Corrections are DATED and say what was wrong, in the house style used by this portfolio's corrections of record. A silently fixed doc teaches nobody why it drifted.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.

userStories.title: Archived, not deleted — and the record says why
acceptanceCriteria: Superseded documents move to `docs/archive/` with a note naming what replaced them and when. Nothing is deleted outright.
Report what was left alone and why — a doc that looks stale but is the record of a decision is not stale, it is history, and this portfolio keeps those deliberately.
State honestly what this sweep did NOT verify. Documentation correctness is not machine-checkable in general, and a claim that the docs are now true is stronger than the method supports.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.
